data_description.bookings_only_feed: Enable only if this calendar never publishes blocked or unavailable dates. Booking.com no longer identifies guests in its feed, so this is required for Booking.com calendars that export booked dates only. Enabling this on a calendar that does publish blocked dates will issue door codes for those blocks.
data_description.cleaning_window: Hours to keep checkout status before returning to no reservation (0.5–48)
data_description.date_only: Displays each reservation as a single all-day block. Guest arrival and departure times are hidden from the calendar.

keymaster_association_repair.title: Repair the Keymaster association
keymaster_association_repair.description: This entry's legacy Keymaster selection is unresolved; Rental Control does not automatically associate entries by name or entity ID. Open this entry's Options and select the intended Keymaster configuration. Until the association is verified, Rental Control withholds setting and clearing door codes. If protected legacy allocations have no independent record identifying their original Keymaster entry, the options form will also require an explicit assertion that the selected entry controls the same original physical lock. Known work from another Keymaster entry cannot be transferred by this assertion.

keymaster_version_outside_support.title: Keymaster version is outside tested support
keymaster_version_outside_support.description: The loaded Keymaster version {version} is below Rental Control's tested support floor {support_floor}. This is a support diagnosis only: version status alone does not block or authorize lock operations. Verify the selected Keymaster entry and its current slot capabilities; update Keymaster where practical.

keymaster_version_unknown.title: Keymaster version could not be classified
keymaster_version_unknown.description: Rental Control could not reliably classify the already-loaded Keymaster version. Verify the installed integration metadata and selected entry. Version status alone does not block or authorize lock operations; each operation still requires current identity, capability, state, and protection checks. Tested stable support begins at {support_floor}.

protected_registry_unknown.title: Shared door-code registry history is unverified
protected_registry_unknown.description: No independently verified, sufficiently complete marker-bearing backup has been established; a markerless v1 backup alone cannot prove completeness. Preserve the current registry, protection marker, and quarantine evidence without editing or restoring files. This release has no supported external restore or override. Issuance, reuse, and release may remain blocked indefinitely, including on installations that never activated v2. This does not establish whether an unverified code is present, absent, visible, or reusable.

protected_registry_scan_incomplete.title: Protected registry evidence scan is incomplete
protected_registry_scan_incomplete.description: The bounded evidence scan was incomplete or exceeded its limit; the incomplete scan cannot establish that quarantine evidence is absent. Preserve the current registry, protection marker, and quarantine evidence. With Home Assistant stopped, resolve the storage scan problem without editing or restoring files, then reload Rental Control. This release has no supported external restore or override. Issuance, reuse, and release remain blocked until history can be verified.

set_slot_exclusion.name: Set slot exclusion
set_slot_exclusion.description: Exclude one permanently unreadable managed lock slot from the door code issuance gate, or restore it. An excluded slot is still reconciled and still counts as evidence that a code may be programmed, so a code the integration cannot see may remain on the lock; verify the slot physically before excluding it. The exclusion clears itself as soon as the slot becomes readable again or leaves the managed range, and saving the entry's options discards it.
